solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Weapon launcher in Navy port to be due for modification

indicators.note: a modification is a change, so the letters of these words are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A naval port is due to have its weapon launcher modified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for modification' tells you to rearrange PORT and TO BE DUE; 'for' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A warship fires its torpedoes from tubes, so this is the Navy's launching device for that weapon.

clue.text: This oven has ring outside for roasting

indicators.note: roasting has the letters of ring, R and then ING, wrapped around the outside of the answer, which sits within it

explanation.surface: An oven with a ring burner outside is used for roasting.
explanation.walkthrough: Here 'ring' is not a circle or O: R and ING literally surround the oven inside 'roasting'.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiln for drying hops, a familiar sight in Kent, is a kind of oven.

clue.text: Left or right in vessel

parts.note: on board ship the left-hand side has its own nautical name; 'or right' is a tease, since the opposite side is starboard

explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the left side looking forward is called the port side.

clue.text: Only a fraction may be claimed

indicators.note: suggests the letters of claimed may be something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: Only part of what is owed may be claimed.
explanation.definitionFit: A decimal is a way of writing a fraction such as 0.5, so it represents a portion of a whole.

clue.text: Try at an international match

definitions.meaning: to put something on trial or examine it
a full international cricket or rugby fixture

explanation.surface: Someone scores a try in an international match.
explanation.definitionFit: To test is to try out; a Test is a full international match in cricket or rugby.

clue.text: Flags for CND supporters?

parts.note: the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament wanted to ban the bomb, so its supporters could be called people who ban

explanation.surface: Protest flags are carried by nuclear disarmament campaigners.
explanation.walkthrough: CND is Britain's Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament; its marchers carried flags, and 'ban-ners' are those who would ban the bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Banners are flags carried on poles, and in the pun they are also people who want to ban something.

clue.text: Receive an order to assume control

definitions.meaning: literally to accept a command given to you
to take charge of a situation or unit

explanation.surface: A soldier receives an order to take charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase means accepting a command; as an idiom it means taking charge.

clue.text: Quite satisfied with what spring holds?

definitions.meaning: a spring is a well, and its contents are what it holds

explanation.surface: Someone is quite satisfied with what a spring contains.
explanation.definitionFit: As an idiom the phrase means fully satisfied; read literally it is the contents of a well, which a spring is.

clue.text: Animal was in form when very young

definitions.text: Animal was in form when very young

parts.words: Animal was in form when very young
parts.note: a form is the shallow nest where a certain long-eared animal raises its young, so 'in form' is literal, not about fitness

explanation.definitionFit: This long-eared animal shelters its newborn leverets in a hollow called a form.

clue.text: Trouble raising cost when sending to Coventry

indicators.note: to trouble something is to stir it up, so the letters of these words are disturbed

explanation.surface: Raising costs causes trouble when goods are sent to Coventry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sending to Coventry' is a British idiom for refusing to speak to someone; Coventry is an English city.
explanation.definitionFit: To send someone to Coventry is to shun them, which is exactly excluding them socially.

clue.text: He will shortly create uproar

parts.note: taken as written
will contracted to its short form, as in an apostrophe and two Ls

explanation.surface: He will soon cause a commotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He will shortly' is the contraction HE'LL, which spelt without its apostrophe is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Hell can mean noisy chaos, as in 'all hell broke loose'.

clue.text: Being under age, they won't win the vote

definitions.meaning: the legal state of being a minor
the smaller group in a ballot, outnumbered by the majority

explanation.surface: Youngsters under age cannot win the vote.
explanation.definitionFit: Minority is the state of being a minor, and the minority is the side with fewer votes.

clue.text: Unusual order to stand aside

definitions.meaning: a command telling someone to move aside

explanation.surface: Someone is given an unusual instruction to step aside.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means remote or out of the ordinary, and shouted it tells someone to clear the path.

clue.text: Poet so human in composition

indicators.note: composition means putting together, so the letters of so human are composed afresh

explanation.surface: A poet is so human in his writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A. E. Housman was an English poet, best known for A Shropshire Lad.

clue.text: Annie celebrates having this other girl in the family

definitions.text: this other girl in the family

indicators.note: the phrase Annie celebrates has, or contains, the letters needed across its two words

explanation.surface: Annie celebrates along with another girl in her family.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is a relative, a sibling's daughter, so another girl in the family tree.

clue.text: Musical effect involving quavers?

parts.note: quavers are eighth notes, but here they are wavering, trembling sounds

explanation.definitionFit: A tremolo is a rapid trembling repetition of a note, a musical effect that quavers.

clue.text: It has been known to be tickled to death

definitions.text: It has been known to be tickled to death

parts.words: It has been known to be tickled to death
parts.note: a certain river fish can be caught by stroking its belly by hand until it can be lifted out, so tickling is fatal for it

explanation.definitionFit: Trout tickling is the old poacher's method of catching this fish by stroking it.

clue.text: They falsify their accounts

parts.note: accounts look like financial books but are the stories people tell

explanation.definitionFit: Liars are people who give untrue versions of events.

clue.text: State of mind caused by a turn of fate

indicators.note: turning the word round means reading it backwards

parts.note: doom means fate or destiny

explanation.surface: A frame of mind brought on by a twist of fate.
explanation.definitionFit: A mood is a temporary emotional state.

clue.text: Neglect to ring a man back

parts.note: a ring is round, like the letter O

indicators.note: the man's name is written backwards

parts.note: Tim is a man's name

explanation.surface: Someone forgets to phone a man back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' suggests a phone call, which fits the surface of neglecting to call back, but here it is just the round letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To omit something is to leave it out or neglect to do it.

clue.text: Get rid of undergrowth

explanation.surface: Clear away the undergrowth.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub a plan is to cancel it, and scrub is also low bushy vegetation.

clue.text: The rest of the foot in the cavalry

definitions.text: The rest of the foot in the cavalry

parts.words: The rest of the foot in the cavalry
parts.note: the rest looks like the remainder of the foot soldiers, but it is a rest for a rider's foot

explanation.definitionFit: A stirrup is the loop hanging from a saddle in which a rider's foot rests.

clue.text: Provide supervision for a small charge

definitions.text: Provide supervision for a small charge

parts.words: Provide supervision for a small charge
parts.note: a small charge looks like a low fee but is a little child in someone's care

explanation.definitionFit: To babysit is to look after a young child while the parents are out.

clue.text: Chemical container returned with speed

indicators.note: the word for the container is sent back, written in reverse

parts.note: a tin is a container
rate means speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: A chemical container is sent back quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' looks like sending the container back, but it only reverses the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitrate is a salt of nitric acid, a chemical compound used in fertilisers.

clue.text: Admitted being deceived?

definitions.meaning: let in or received as a guest

explanation.surface: Someone admits to having been fooled.
explanation.definitionFit: To be taken in is both to be admitted indoors and to be fooled.

clue.text: Rock music you can dance to

definitions.meaning: a lively Scottish or Irish folk dance and its tune

explanation.surface: Rock music that is good for dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: To reel is to stagger as if rocking, and a reel is a fast folk dance.

clue.text: Down-at-heel wear for a rider

parts.note: down-at-heel looks like shabby, but it describes something worn low on the heel of a rider's boot

explanation.definitionFit: A spur is a spiked device fixed to a rider's heel to urge a horse on.

clue.text: Man races in circles

indicators.note: the races are placed inside the circles

parts.note: two circles look like two letter Os
the TT races are the Tourist Trophy motorcycle races held on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man races round in circles.
explanation.walkthrough: The TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man, which neatly echoes 'Man'.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto is a man's first name.

clue.text: The philosophy of Goya, perhaps

indicators.note: signals that the painter's name is perhaps something else once its letters are reworked

explanation.surface: The thinking behind Goya's art, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoga is a Hindu philosophy and discipline of meditation and posture.

clue.text: Scheme that gives a little professional status

parts.note: pro is professional shortened
position means standing or status

explanation.surface: A plan that gives a junior professional some standing.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposition is a suggested scheme or plan put forward for consideration.

clue.text: After tea make a half century or a duck

indicators.note: the letter for fifty comes after the drink

parts.note: taken as written
L is the Roman numeral for fifty, half of a hundred

explanation.surface: After the tea interval a batsman scores fifty or is out for nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a half century is 50 runs and a duck is a score of nought; but here the duck is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The teal is a small freshwater duck.

clue.text: Working is a matter of choice — about time!

indicators.note: the word for a matter of choice goes about, or around, the word for a time

parts.note: optional means left to choice
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Whether it works is up to you, and about time too!
explanation.walkthrough: The dash and exclamation make 'about time!' look like an impatient aside; in fact 'about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Operational means in working order, functioning.
